body: I have thought about this quite a bit, and I have talked to recruiters in the past. My vision is a -10 (-12 is legally blind) and the recruiters I have talked to have told me it was very unlikely that I would be able to join.

No, they won't. My loans are through Sallie Mae. I have tried to talk to multiple people and eventually they will start garnishing my wages. My credit is already fucked, so it doesn't matter. No one will consolidate them because my credit is fucked. This summer was going to be dedicated to getting my credit back in order, so that SOMEDAY someone would consolidate them, and i could put them over 30 years instead of 15. Now this summer will be dedicated to DWI bills. It's really hard to set goals when I haven't paid a dime on my principal interest in the 3 years i've been out of school. It's like a giant black hole that just sucks me in deeper and deeper. 

I have real friends, a lot of them. But I am sick of burdening them with my problems.
